title: Circuit Runner
shortDescription: Jump the hurdles. Slide the lasers. Outrun your to-do list.
description: Sprint a little robot down a three-lane neon highway at dusk. Jump striped hurdles, slide under laser gates, and switch lanes around data crates. Grab energy cells in quick succession to build up to a ×5 multiplier. The city keeps speeding up until something breaks.
coverAlt: Circuit Runner gameplay with a robot on a neon three-lane highway toward a synthwave sunset and glowing city towers
controls: Use the left and right arrow keys or A and D to switch lanes. Up, W or Space jumps; Down or S slides, and slams you down mid-air.
On a touchscreen, swipe left, right, up or down, or tap the left or right half of the screen to switch lanes.
Jump hurdles, slide under laser gates, and steer around crates. M toggles audio. After a crash, press Space or Enter, tap, or use Run again.
saveNote: Your best score and mute preference are stored locally on the game's Cloudflare origin. Runs are not saved, and there is no pause key; switching tabs freezes the run. Browsers may block or partition embedded storage, so your best may differ from the original game. Blocked storage does not prevent playing; open the original for its own saved records.
